mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 6 months compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced cost of capital for corporate valuations.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in >55% of instances with FEDFUNDS decline over 6 months, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 4.0% with accelerating increases signals aggressive monetary tightening that elevates equity risk premiums, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in >55% of instances with FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and accelerating increases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and rise in non-farm payrolls indicates robust labor market conditions that accelerate corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Joint signal of UNRATE decline and PAYEMS rise fails to generate positive 20-day returns in >55% of cases, or interaction term coefficient p>0.05 in regression.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1800 thousand units signals strong consumer demand for residential construction, boosting retail and manufacturing activity that elevates S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in >55% of periods with HOUST > 1800 thousand units, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment rate trend over 6 months indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profit growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in >55% of instances with UNRATE rise over 6 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% with accelerating increases signals weakening labor market conditions that depress consumer confidence and corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in >55% of instances with UNRATE > 5.0% and accelerating increases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPI inflation acceleration and industrial production decline indicates stagflationary pressures that increase equity risk premiums and reduce earnings visibility, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Joint signal of CPIAUCSL rise and INDPRO decline fails to generate negative 20-day returns in >55% of cases, or interaction term coefficient p<0.05 with positive sign.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production index below 115 signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output capacity and earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days during supply shocks.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in >55% of periods with INDPRO < 115, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.
